items.quote: on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man
items.claim: On the sixth day the people gathered twice the usual amount of bread, two omers per person.
items.object: twice as much bread, two omers for one man

items.quote: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses
items.claim: All the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses that twice as much bread had been gathered on the sixth day.
items.actor: all the rulers of the congregation
